participation.context: Said what he had not said in the shop, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: I did not give it to him.

story.body: You named the gap between his cheerful sizes and the near five pounds, and you left that gap in the room you were not in with him. The scrap was already back behind the panel.

relations.quote: I did not give it to him.

title: Did not say the near five pounds
